message.content: Keysight sells design, emulation and test solutions that span the full engineering lifecycle, to technology innovators whose work sits in AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor and general electronics [D1]. The company reports two segments, and the larger, Communications Solutions Group, generated $1,345 million of revenue in the quarter ended July 31, 2026, up 43.09 percent from a year earlier, with growth coming from commercial communications and from aerospace, defense and government [D1]. The smaller, Electronic Industrial Solutions Group, generated $501 million of revenue in the same quarter and grew 21.6 percent, with growth across the semiconductor, general electronics, and automotive and energy markets [D1]. Revenue across the two segments totaled $1,846 million in that quarter [D1].
